sampling_model.design: Independent sampling from the one coherent joint law \(p_H(V,S)\) with selector support exactly \(H\).
sampling_model.units: Observed units are i.i.d. draws of \((V,S)\); latent roots and response types are not observed.
sampling_model.treatment: The observed treatment components may be natural or selector-overridden according to the known gate encoded by \(S\); the target sets \(A=a\) and \(S=s_{\emptyset}\).
sampling_model.overlap: The proposal maintains the novel restricted-support condition \(p_H(c)>0\) only for structurally admissible cells \(c\in\mathcal C_H^{\mathrm{adm}}(G^{+})\), with no common numerical lower bound and no law supplied for \(s\notin H\). It guarantees the context normalizers, reachable fixing margins, and certified rational-elimination denominator factors recorded in \(\mathcal L_H^{\mathrm{pos}}\). Statistical inference is pointwise at a fixed differentiable interior point of the returned branch domain.
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: The positive branch estimates the one finite supported-cell table empirically and evaluates its partial rational circuit only when the empirical table lies in the complete registered positive semialgebraic domain. An off-domain sample returns \(\bot_H\) and no point estimate or confidence set.

comparator_promise_table.comparator_claim: Algorithms 1--2 are sound, specified failure branches imply nonidentification, and completeness is conjectured.
Ordinary semi-Markovian ID is complete through identifying formulas or hedge countermodels.
Positive gID is sound and complete by reduction to classical ID subproblems.
Root-control CSI identification is equivalent to finitely many ordinary graphical identification problems.
Finite canonical SCMs represent all categorical counterfactual distributions and yield sharp polynomial-program bounds.
The arithmetic-circuit method is at least as complete as classical ID and do-calculus under strict positivity and can exploit additional model constraints.
Sufficient pruning and transit-clustering conditions preserve identification conclusions and transport do-calculus functionals.
Influence-function and weight-based estimators are derived for broad classes of identified effects in hidden-variable graphical models.

body.tldr: For a finite selector-gated semi-Markovian SCM observed on exactly \(H\), construct a raw normalized carrier from retained active and dormant primitive response tables, impose gate and support constraints independently, and prove inverse maps to the original parameterization. SA-CS-ID is an executable four-transition machine: each selector correction, reachable fixing, labelled rational elimination, and residual compilation has an exact eligibility predicate, successor, emitted object, polynomial proof obligation, positivity-ledger certificate, and lexicographically decreasing state measure. Every branch returns either a partial rational circuit with its complete positive semialgebraic domain or support-exact global twins. The fixed-support class is a generally strict subclass of the 2024 model class, so its negative certificate must preserve exact support and every supplied joint-law cell. A worked selector-gated trace produces the explicit \(1/2\) versus \(63/128\) twins, and each positive branch yields explicitly vectorized componentwise and fixed-contrast pointwise Wald intervals. The open step is proving that every residual verifier finds a rational projection or a common contrast.

project_justification.gap: The published systematic-selection recursion is sound and has branchwise nonidentification results, but its completeness is conjectural and its failure construction is not typed as a support-exact, restricted-interior pair preserving every cell of the one supplied joint law. Its proofs also do not normalize a declared selector support while retaining the exact structural parameter image.
project_justification.niche: Fixed support is neither ordinary observational identification nor gID from separately supplied experiments: absent contexts cannot be invoked, while supported contexts remain coupled by one random selector and shared natural mechanisms.
project_justification.fill: The project constructs the intrinsic normalized carrier \(\Lambda_H\), proves its constrained subset \(\mathcal I_H\) equals the original fixed-support image, and develops an exact four-relation SA-CS-ID machine with local algebraic obligations, a denominator-by-denominator positivity ledger, deterministic priority, and a per-transition lexicographic decrease. Its all-residual theorem returns a partial rational formula with a complete positive domain or support-exact global twins; component and fixed-linear-contrast Wald intervals use a declared vectorization and have pointwise coverage only at a fixed interior law.

body.related_work: Lee, Ghassami, and Shpitser (2024) provide the selector-gated model, Algorithms 1--2, soundness in Theorem 4, branchwise witnesses in Theorem 5, and an explicit completeness conjecture; after matching selector syntax, the present \(\Theta_H\) is the intersection of their model class with exact support \(H\) and the restricted admissible-cell interior, while their failure-output guarantee is not a subset of the support-exact full-table twin relation. Kivva, Mokhtarian, Etesami, and Kiyavash (2022) inform positivity-correct witness rebuilding for gID with separately supplied laws; they do not state the structural-zero and fixed-selector-support positivity condition maintained here. Mokhtarian, Jamshidi, Etesami, and Kiyavash (2022) inform finite context decomposition for observed root controls rather than a potentially confounded selector. Shpitser and Pearl (2006) provide the ordinary formula-or-hedge endpoint recovered when selection disappears. Zhang, Tian, and Bareinboim (2022) provide finite canonical response types, but not a retained fixed-support selector image. The accessible primary record for Chen and Darwiche is the 2025 AAAI AICT workshop paper and arXiv:2412.02869; Definitions 2--3 formulate constrained identifiability, Sections 4--5 give arithmetic-circuit and invariant-cut tests, and the proved comparison is at least-as-complete behavior for classical strict-positivity identification, so it informs rather than supplies the fixed-support converse. Tabell, Tikka, and Karvanen (2026) give sufficient graph reductions and formula transport for general data fusion, not inverse parameter maps or all-branch twins for an endogenous selector. Tikka, Hyttinen, and Karvanen (2021) supply the dosearch software consumer.
body.technical_internal_limitation: The terminal response contrast and the explicit worked twins do not prove that the finite residual candidate library succeeds on every interacting-district state. A residual may require a nonrational algebraic functional, or every signed row-swap contrast may alter an observed descendant. Either event defeats the rational formula-or-global-twin headline and requires a pivot. The machine therefore treats candidate existence as the named open theorem, not as an implicit rule. Boundary-uniform inference, off-domain regularization, and unrestricted quantifier elimination remain outside scope.
body.honest_scope: To prove are the two inclusions equating the independently constructed normalized carrier constraints with the original fixed-support image; local soundness and lexicographic decrease for each of the four explicit transitions; positivity of every selector, fixing, and elimination denominator admitted by the branch ledger; preservation of the published positive branches; the strict-class and witness-relation comparison with the 2024 failure construction; success of the residual verifier on every irreducible state; all-branch formula-or-global-twin completeness; the ordinary-ID reduction; the exact worked execution; and pointwise interior componentwise and fixed-linear-contrast Wald coverage under the declared vectorization. The restricted-support admissible-cell interior is a novel maintained condition, not a condition attributed to Kivva and coauthors. No uniform lower bound is imposed. The empirical convention abstains off the returned branch domain. The early kill test replays the explicit twins and the \(156\) terminal configurations and then adds one observed mediator at the same two contexts.
